admitted.why: The synthetic pilot party's own native result. Public, non-sensitive, no WEXP or EMILIA semantics.
The pilot's own axis-separated terminal record. Not a semantic result about any protocol.
The one-run ticket that authorized this dispatch, so a reader can check what was granted.
The unprivileged validation receipt the ticket was issued against.
The exact request bytes that were validated and admitted.
How to re-run this without the workflow.
The frozen per-file manifest the immutability check verifies against.

non_claims: Admission to this list is a publication decision, not a security proof.
A file admitted here is still subject to every deny rule the scan applies.
This allowlist covers the synthetic self-service pilot only. It grants nothing to any real counterparty.
note: Exact paths only. Deny by default: any staged file not named here fails the gate closed. Wildcards are refused by the gate itself, not merely absent here.
